data.title: Al-Ittihad to Host Uzbekistan's Pakhtakor in AFC Champions League Elite Tomorrow
data.content:
Jeddah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Saudi Arabia's Al-Ittihad will host Uzbekistan's Pakhtakor tomorrow at King Abdullah Sports City Stadium in Jeddah in the fifth round of the West Region league stage of the 2026–2027 AFC Champions League Elite.
    Al-Ittihad will seek to return to winning ways and strengthen its chances of advancing to the next round, drawing confidence from its favorable record against Pakhtakor. The two sides have met four times, with Al-Ittihad remaining unbeaten and winning three of those encounters. The Jeddah-based side will also look to secure its first home win in this season's competition after losing both previous home matches.
    The match comes at a crucial stage for Al-Ittihad, which needs all three points after suffering a 4–1 defeat to the UAE's Al-Ain. With four points, the team currently sits 10th in the standings and needs positive results in its remaining matches to improve its chances of reaching the round of 16.
    Pakhtakor, meanwhile, has two points and will be looking to improve its position. However, the Uzbek side faces a difficult away challenge, having failed to win any of its last six away matches in the AFC Champions League Elite, recording three draws and three defeats.
    Al-Ain currently leads the West Region standings with 12 points, followed by Al-Hilal, Esteghlal, and Shabab Al-Ahli, each with nine points. Al-Qadsiah and Saudi Arabia's Al-Ahli have eight points apiece, while Al-Nassr has six points from three matches.
    Al-Shamal follows with five points, while Neftchi and Al-Ittihad have four points each. Al-Wasl and Air Force SC have three points apiece, followed by Tractor, Pakhtakor, and Al-Sadd with two points each. Al-Gharafa remains without a point.
    -- SPA
